content: keys wire tests: STUB remap_is_set reads thread_local REMAP_SET (default Ok(false)); tests expecting 'caps lock remap: set' must set it and reset it after.

description: Hyper (Caps Lock) died for hours when any app leaked macOS secure input: a user-level CGEventTap and IOHIDManager see no key down/up, posted modifier flagsChanged do not combine with hardware keys, and Carbon hotkeys do not match while a non-modifier (F18) is held. Check: ioreg kCGSSessionSecureInputPID (holder may be a dead pid; only lock/unlock clears it).
resolution: Under secure input the tap still sees flagsChanged and Carbon hotkeys with real modifiers still fire: Caps maps to Right Control and a ctrl layer of Carbon hotkeys is registered while it is held (flick-1271).
